hypotheses.hypothesis: Global-English independent career-transition coaches may pay for a source-labeled, human-reviewed, U.S.-basis automation-transition planning artifact. This is a hypothesis — not a uniqueness or product-market-fit claim.
load_bearing_claims: Career coaches have a recurring costly workflow researching automation exposure for clients
The product artifact addresses this workflow with source-labeled O*NET grounding
Coaches will pay $49 for a 5-report credit pack without a free trial
hypotheses.evidence_support: Codebase evidence (E-003, E-004, E-005) shows product exists with pilot pricing configured. Web research (E-012) confirms coaching market size. ICF 2025 study (E-017) provides market size reference.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: No first-party evidence of WTP. Intry's $149 tier is a pricing reference, not proof that coaches will buy this product (E-018). White-label career/coaching platforms already exist (E-019) — uniqueness must be demonstrated at workflow-and-evidence level. ICF 2025 count (122,974) does not establish demand from career coaches specifically (E-017).

evidence_bundle.claim: Career coaches have a recurring costly workflow researching automation exposure for clients
The product artifact addresses this workflow with source-labeled O*NET grounding
Coaches will pay $49 for a 5-report credit pack without a free trial

hypotheses.hypothesis: O*NET data grounding is a defensible differentiator that career coaches value because it provides government-source credibility that ChatGPT and generic AI tools cannot replicate.
load_bearing_claims: O*NET government data sourcing is a perceived differentiator that coaches value over generic AI analysis
AIJobImpactCalculator also uses O*NET but as a free B2C tool without coach-specific workflow
hypotheses.evidence_support: Codebase evidence (E-001, E-005) shows O*NET integration in product. ForCoachesPage (E-003) references O*NET grounding in positioning.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: AIJobImpactCalculator also uses O*NET (B2C free). White-label as a category is not unique — Coaching.com and RapidDev offer white-label coaching platforms (E-019). Uniqueness must be demonstrated at the workflow-and-evidence level (source labeling, human-review boundary, proof-pack system), not claimed as category-unique. No first-party evidence that coaches value O*NET grounding specifically.

evidence_bundle.claim: O*NET government data sourcing is a perceived differentiator that coaches value over generic AI analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bridge role pathfinding (skill overlap to adjacent safer roles) may be a capability that coaches value for showing clients actionable transition paths. Uniqueness must be demonstrated at the workflow-and-evidence level — Kairo offers similar adjacent role paths (B2C free beta). This is a hypothesis, not a uniqueness claim.
load_bearing_claims: Bridge role pathfinding is a capability coaches value for showing clients actionable transition paths
This capability is differentiated from Kairo's free B2C adjacent role feature
hypotheses.evidence_support: Codebase evidence (E-005) shows bridge role functionality exists in the product. ForCoachesPage (E-003) references transition pathfinding in positioning.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: Kairo offers similar adjacent role paths (B2C free beta). No evidence of coach demand for this specific feature. No first-party data on whether coaches use or value bridge role pathfinding.

evidence_bundle.claim: Bridge role pathfinding is a capability coaches value for showing clients actionable transition paths

hypotheses.hypothesis: The 50+ pre-built SEO occupation pages at /automation-risk/:slug will drive organic traffic that converts to free-tier signups, which funnel to coach outreach via upgrade prompts.
load_bearing_claims: Organic SEO traffic can acquire users at meaningful scale for the automation-risk landing pages
Free-tier signups from SEO will funnel to coach outreach via upgrade prompts
hypotheses.evidence_support: Codebase evidence (E-008) shows 50+ SEO landing pages with structured data exist. Analytics infrastructure (E-007) is in place for tracking.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: 12+ free competitors have SEO head start. WillRobotsTakeMyJob has 8+ years of domain authority. Deferred until coach motion clears paid-pilot gate per Codex 5.6 recommendation.

evidence_bundle.claim: Organic SEO traffic can acquire users at meaningful scale for the automation-risk landing pages

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coaches will pay $49 for 5 report credits without a free trial, demonstrating willingness-to-pay for the artifact before scaling to Coach Pro at $149/mo.
load_bearing_claims: Career coaches will pay $49 for a 5-report credit pack without a free trial
This WTP validates the path to Coach Pro at $149/mo
hypotheses.evidence_support: Stripe pricing (E-004) shows $49/5-credit pack configured with real Stripe price IDs. Pilot-only offering is active.
hypotheses.counter_evidence: No first-party evidence. The $49/5-credit pack exists in stripe.ts but has zero sales. Intry's $149 is a price anchor only (E-018), not WTP proof for this product.

evidence_bundle.claim: Career coaches will pay $49 for a 5-report credit pack without a free trial
